analysis.purpose: Translates input flags into state flags, augments them from a state selector, filters them against the current node, and searches a 64-byte-entry table after an unsigned counter exceeds its bound. Exact gameplay terminology remains uncertain.
analysis.observed_abi: a0 is an object pointer. The second word argument in a1 is homed but unused. The function uses a 24-byte stack frame. Inspected callers ignore its result; the C uses void, but that does not establish the original return type.

calls.observed_abi: a0=object; a1=Boolean(A58&0x40) when A58&0x20 is set, otherwise zero; a2=A58&0x20. Result ignored; original return type uncertain. Alias resolves to zero; identity comes from this site's recovered relocation.

evidence: Normal and NON_MATCHING C both match the immutable expected object and original assembly: 852 bytes, 213/213 words.
Final ROM is byte-identical to baserom; MD5 fa27089c425dbab99f19245c5c997613. All six compressed-block checks pass.
No regressions among 39 previously exact functions in this unit. Only the assigned function body changed.

Inspected callers F424, F664, 10068, 10128, 102CC, 10408 and 104A4, plus related E35C and callee EAF4. Recovered shared GameState, GameStateActor, GameStateInput and GameStateNode partial definitions in the assigned source.
Object offsets: B4 actor pointer; E8 flags; EC unsigned counter; F0/F4/F8 node pointers; FC word; 100 counter; 114 word; 124/126/128 signed halfwords; 12C selector; 214 unsigned bound.
Actor offsets: 800 input pointer, 8C0 flags, 938 word, 9A8 flags, A18 word and A58 flags. Input accesses include words 10/18 and signed halfword 7C.
Node/table offsets: 2C, 30, 34, 38 and 3C; table stride 0x40. E35C transfers F0 into F4, supporting the shared node layout.
Corrected unconditional helper invocation, selector 12C instead of E8, the 9A8-bit search condition, and clearing gated by counter overflow.
Table-base relocation at original 0xE85C identifies game_uso_D_807FFBC0. Count import at 0xE6C0 remains recorded as unpaired.

Fresh upstream port: original compiler in both modes, complete native call/data USO identity checks, exact source-generated tables/constants, exact host function bytes, full ROM and all six strict original code-block payloads.
